title: Experts disagree on runtime/claude-plugin/mod/register.tsx
context:

Target: runtime/claude-plugin/mod/register.tsx
- security-auditor: no tool.check hook in the mod returns anything except what next(e) gave it, and the new tool.call hook retries next(e) at most once per call
- application-architect: the mod keeps exactly one tool.check hook and it returns what next(e) gave it; Allow once moves to a tool.call hook on Edit, Write and NotebookEdit placed after the unmatched tool.call hook so that hook stays outermost
